articles.company_name: Calamos Long/Short Equity & Dynamic Income Trust
articles.summary: Elevated rates and narrow, whipsawing market breadth continue to align well with Calamos Hedged Equity Fund’s dynamic approach. The team rolled its base hedge to December 2027, targeting 60%–65% upside and 35%–40% downside participation, while actively trading around the edges to enhance returns.
articles.title: Staying Agile Pays Off

articles.company_name: Calamos Long/Short Equity & Dynamic Income Trust
articles.summary: CMNIX outperformed bonds in Q2 and year to date, driven by gains across convertible arbitrage, hedged equity, merger arbitrage, and SPAC arbitrage. Record convertible issuance, including Alphabet's landmark deal, and a favorable merger environment support the fund’s multi-strategy, market-agnostic approach to steady performance.
articles.title: Running at a Steady Pace as Bonds Limp Along

articles.company_name: Calamos Long/Short Equity & Dynamic Income Trust
articles.summary: Global equities rallied in Q2 2026, led by emerging markets and earnings-driven growth stocks. The Calamos global team sees fundamentals, not momentum, powering markets, and diversifies across secular, cyclical, and defensive growth themes, including AI infrastructure, healthcare, and emerging-market consumption. Inflation and geopolitical risks remain key watch points.
articles.title: Global Markets: Fundamentals Have the Floor

articles.company_name: Calamos Long/Short Equity & Dynamic Income Trust
articles.summary: Autocallable ETFs are expanding rapidly within the derivative-income market. Head of ETFs Matt Kaufman outlines seven key questions advisors should ask when evaluating these ETFs, highlighting Calamos's CAIE and CAIQ as disciplined, transparent options built on volatility-targeted, laddered index structures.
articles.title: Beyond the Coupon: How to Evaluate a Growing Autocallable ETF Category

articles.company_name: Calamos Long/Short Equity & Dynamic Income Trust
articles.summary: “Markets never move in a straight line, even when they are trending upward over time,” notes Founder and Global CIO John P. Calamos, Sr. in his July introduction to the Investment Team Outlooks. Amid record convertible issuance and broadening equity leadership, he emphasizes vigilance around Fed policy, geopolitical risk, and portfolio rebalancing.
articles.title: Calamos Investment Team Outlooks, July 2026

articles.company_name: Calamos Long/Short Equity & Dynamic Income Trust
articles.summary: AI infrastructure dominance and a hawkish Fed are reshaping the investment landscape. Calamos Phineus Long/Short Fund manager Michael Grant sees broadening but concentrated market leadership, expects inflation to surprise to the downside, and anticipates a topping process through autumn as positioning risk and midterm election uncertainty intensify.
articles.title: Everything Shaken, Little Really Stirred

articles.company_name: Calamos Long/Short Equity & Dynamic Income Trust
articles.summary: Markets in 2026 hover between resilient earnings and narrow, momentum-driven gains, with valuations near dot-com-era extremes. SROIX favors diversified, quality companies with strong balance sheets and reasonable valuations across sectors and geographies, positioning for resilience when momentum inevitably reverses and market participation broadens.
articles.title: In a Tightrope Market, Discipline Is the Balancing Pole
